tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis bsdad la/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi// chos la skyabs su mchi// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du ting nge 'dzin zab mo bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswabhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi lus mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sangs kyis bsgom/ de nas rang nyid skad cig gis rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la sems can gyi don mdzad par skul ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas phreng ba dkar po dang*/ g.yon gyi 'og mas rin po che dang bcas pa'i padma 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' mnabs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ spyi bo na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgoms la yid cung zad gzung*/ de nas spyi bo'i 'od dpag tu med pa la dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rgyas pa dang*/

yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de nas bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtsa ba thams cad rang gi sems yin la/ sems de'ang brtags na kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ gcig dang du ma yang ma yin pas rang gi ngo bos stong*/ ngo bo med pa'i dbang gis gdod ma nas skye ba med pas dang po rgyus stong*/ skye ba med pa'i phyir sdod pa med pas bar du gnas pas stong*/ gnas rgyu med pa'i phyir 'jig pa med pas tha ma 'gags pas stong pas gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes spros pa bcad la/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi bsgom zhing yid la mi byed par spros bral gyi ngang la yid lhod de mnyam par bzhag phyis nas goms pa dang*/ sems mi 'phro zhing nang du gnas pa yun ring du 'byung*/ de nas rang gi snying gar hrīḥbasgom pa las sngags kyi phreng ba 'od kyi tshul du 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul nas bdag la byin gyis rlob cing sems can gyi don mdzad par bsgoms nas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes ci nus pa bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig ces bsngo'o// spyod lam gyi tshe rang 'dug pa'i gnas bde ba can yin la/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i zhabs drung na jo bo thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gnas yin snyam pa'i bsam pa dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na tshe 'dir tshe ring zhing bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ skye ba phyi mar bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// jo bo thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul/

rje sa skya pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di rang gi slob ma mo ston tsa ge ju 'phur zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la skye rgu mdor yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang thugs rje'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal kun thugs rje gcig gyur sems dpa'i tshul// thugs rje che dang phyag rgya chen po dag /zung 'jug nyams su len tshul rjes gnang bcas// sa skya'i 'jam mgon las byung deng 'dir spel// 'dir 'phags pa thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang dpal ldan sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ gnas dben par maṇḍal la dri bzang gis thig le byas la tshom bu gcig bkod/ mtha' skor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gcig bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs nas rol mo dharmā ra ṇi dang bcas pas byin brlabs nas/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed spyi ltar byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi lus mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sangs kyis dag par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas thams cad la sems can gyi don mdzad par skul ba/ g.yas 'og mas phreng ba dkar po dang*/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang bcas pa'i padma 'dzin pa/

zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ spyi bo na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur par bsgoms la yid cung zad gzung*/ de nas spyi bo'i 'od dpag med la dmigs nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyong zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes snying thag pa nas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas 'di ltar bsam ste/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems yin la/ sems de'ang brtags na kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ gcig dang du ma'ang ma yin pas rang gi ngo bos stong*/ ngo bo med pa'i dbang gis gdod ma nas skye ba med pas dang po rgyus stong*/ skye ba med pa'i phyir sdod pa med pas bar du gnas pas stong*/ gnas rgyu med pa'i phyir 'jig pa med pas tha ma 'gags pas stong ste/ gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes spros pa bcad la mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi bsgom zhing yid la mi byed par spros bral gyi ngang la yid lhod de mnyam par bzhag des skyo bar gyur pa na sngags bzla ste/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer sngags kyi tshul du 'phros pas/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul nas rigs drug sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus te bdag gi snying gar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo'o// thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul lo// mdun gyi maṇḍal tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdakar po las thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sogs nas/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su hrīḥ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig par bstim slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsam/

mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod dharmā ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ 'dod don dngos grub zhu/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal 'debs rgyas bsdus gang rung byas/ 'dir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi ba thams cad grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la maṇḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ slob dpon 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang tha mi dad snyam pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul/ phyag me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs dang*/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po sogs nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i sku can rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo la/ rnam pa 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sku tshad med grangs med pa spyan drangs nas khyed rnams kyi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos zhes dang*/ 'bru drug dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ des thugs rje chen po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus thugs rje chen po'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/

sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nasathon khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mthar 'khod par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos brgya rtsa gcig mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ sogs rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar lan brgya rtsa gcig bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas pa spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du thugs rje chen po yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ des thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag thugs rje chen po'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/

thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam re thugs ka nas bye ste byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dang dbyer med du gyur par mos/ de'i ngang las lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de yang je chung je phrar gyur te/ mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar yal te/ bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'khor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa sogs gong ltar brjod nas gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas nas/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi bsgom zhing yid la mi byed pa spros bral gyi ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ des thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag sems thugs rje chen po'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi ltar byas nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang bar bya'o// tshom bu'i lha la mchod bstod byas nas dngos grub gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos thugs rje'i gter// 'phags mchog gru 'dzin dbang po sgrub pa'i thabs// bgyis pa'i dge bas 'gro tshogs srid pa las// gdon pa'i g.yar dam mthar ru phyin par shog /ces dpal sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang thugs rje'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni bla ma gong ma rnams 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la brten nas rjes gnang snyan brgyud kyi tshul du 'bogs pa las sngon chad yi ger bkod pa med mod/

phyi nas de ltar yod pa mi shes pa'i rgyus rgyun nub par 'gyur du dogs nas bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bgyis pa dge'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ratna wardhā ya/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi// mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa// dus 'di nas ni byang chub ma thob bar// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams// gcig tu bsdus pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi mnga' bdag che// zhes pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas la// sgo gsum gus pa= /lung rtogs bdag nyid bstan pa dam chos la// sgo gsum gus= /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// zhes ci nus brjod pa'i mthar/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che// rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// dam chos lam du longs par= lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar= 'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar=chos min rnam rtog 'gag par= byams dang snying rje skye bar= byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par= myur du rnam mkhyen thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab la/ mar gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// don du bla med byang chub thob par bya// de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ chos dbyings mtha' bral chen po'i ngang nyid las// dgos 'dod sna tshogs stsal ba'i rin chen khri// 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos padma'i gdan// rang bzhin 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// bdag nyid sangs rgyas kun dngos spyan ras gzigs// dri med dung dang chu shel lta bu'i mdog /shin tu yid 'ong 'dzum zhal zhi zhing sgeg /phyag bzhi'i dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar// 'og ma shel phreng nor bu padma 'dzin// rab mdzes zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// yid 'phrog dar dang rin chen du mas spras// mthon mthing ral pa'i thor tshugs lcang los mdzes// gang de'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ye shes gcig bsdus skyabs gnas kun gyi gtso// ngo bo bla ma rnam pa 'od dpag med// rigs bdag tshul du dges bzhin bzhugs par gyur// rang nyid lha sku me long gzugs bzhin snang*// snang stong zung du 'jug pa sgyu ma'i gar// gar mkhan bzang ltar cha lugs du mas mdzes// mdzes shing yid 'ong yid kyi snang brnyan no// zhes lha la yid cung zad bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos pa rtse gcig tu byas te/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol// las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag par byin gyis rlobs// tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par= yang dag ting 'dzin skye bar= myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes snying thag pa nas gsol ba lan gsum la sogs pa btab la/ 'khor 'das bde sdug kun la khyab pa'i chos// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems// sems nyid brtags na kha dog dbyibs su med// med phyir gcig dang du ma'i ngo bos stong*// stong pa'i dbang gis skye 'gags gnas gsum bral// bral yang gsal snang ma 'gags spros kun zhi// zhi ba'i sems nyid mtha' bral chen po'o// zhes yid byed thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la lhod de bzhag

snying dbus pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig mthar// yig drug sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis// rgyal ba'i thugs rje bskul nas bdag byin brlabs// 'gro drug sems can rnams kyi don mdzad gyur// par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes lnga brgya la sogs pa bzlas te/ thun 'jog pa na gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos ldan// phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing skyes nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi// khyer so gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral bar// snying rje'i dbang gis sems can don spyod cing*// rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa sgrub par shog /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du// 'dren mchog bla ma 'od dpag med mgon gyi// thugs rje'i lcags kyus nam yang mi gtong bar// srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las skyob gyur cig /ces sogs ci shes pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam btab/ dus thams cad du gnas khang bde ba can gyi zhing du bsams la rang spyan ras gzigs kyi nga rgyal gyis bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhabs 'breng pa byed par bsam zhing sku gsung thugs kyi khyer so gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don bsgrub pa la bslab par bya'o// thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi gdams pa 'di ni/ rang gi slob ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad par byas pa zhig dgos so zhes rgyang ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan du shin tu myur bar bris nas mdo khams shar gyi phyogs su bskur ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug gi brgyud 'debs lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa byin rlabs mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/

rnam 'dren stobs bcu'i dbang phyug shākya'i tog /dgra las rnam rgyal rdo rje gdan pa dang*// ba ri lo tsā sa chen bsod nams rtse// rje btsun grags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya paṇa chen tshogs sgom nyan chen pa// bsod nams skyabs dang gzungs dpal dpal tshul ba// shar chen chos rje ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa' chen po rnams la= kun mkhyen chen po yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// lha mchog sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha'i mtshan// dpal ldan don grub shes rab 'byung gnas dang*// kun dga' legs pa rnams la= sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// nam mkha' bsam 'grub sa chen kun dga'i mtshan// ngag dbang shes rab rin chen grags pa dang*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnams la= rab 'byams sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi// snying rje'i phung po gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzugs// 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i rnam rol can// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// skye kun bshes gnyen mchog gis rjes bzung nas// bcos min nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul te// smon 'jug sems bskyed 'byongs par byis gyis rlobs// khyad par tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs 'phags pa'i sku// snang stong zung 'jug chu zla ltar gsal zhing*// rigs bdag bla ma 'od dpag med mgon gyi// byin rlabs bdud rtsi snying dbus 'jug par shog /de mthus chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems// skye 'gag gnas gsum spros pa las 'das pa'i// brjod bral gnyug ma don gyi 'phags pa mchog /mngon sum mthong nas rtag tu skyong gyur cig /de las ldang tshe thugs srog hrīḥyig mthar// sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas// snying gar thim pas bdag rgyud byin brlabs nas// grags stong bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /mdor na bla ma 'od dpag med mgon zhabs// spyi bo'i padmor 'bral med rtag bsgoms shing*// snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi// dag pa'i rnam rol gcig tu 'char gyur cig

/de ltar bsags las byung ba'i dge tshogs kun// byang chub snying por yongs su bsngos pa'i mthus// 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bstan pa'i srog shing rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang legs grub las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa siddhi rastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
